description: A squat civic building of poured concrete and tall dark windows, wedged onto Kessler Street a single door north of Precinct 9. Chiselled above the lintel, half-legible under decades of grime: HALL OF RECORDS · COLDWATER MUNICIPAL. A brass slot beside the door reads DEPOSIT DEEDS HERE; someone has scratched underneath it, OR WEEP. The street runs on east and west; the door stands open to the north, and usually does.
name: Hall of Records
